name: The Gambia Tourism Board
summary: The official national tourism authority of The Gambia, responsible for destination marketing, licensing tour operators and bird guides, and representing Gambian tourism at international trade fairs. Markets birdwatching as a flagship product with 600+ recorded species.
why_relevant: This is the home delegation — the central convening body for Gambian operators at Global Birdfair and the institutional partner any inbound operator must align with.
engagement_goal: Coordinate joint stand activities, share the list of licensed Gambian bird guides with visiting trade buyers, and capture buyer leads for the GTBoard CRM.

name: Ashanti African Tours Limited
summary: Cape Coast (Ghana) based DMC and West Africa's leading specialist receiving operator for birding and nature tours across Ghana, Benin, Togo, Senegal, São Tomé & Príncipe, Liberia and Sierra Leone. Claims that over 90% of the world's largest birding tour companies use its ground services.
why_relevant: The dominant B2B incoming handler for West African birding — they already operate alongside The Gambia geographically and could either compete with or feed Gambian DMCs. Strategic to engage as a regional peer/coopetitor and understand which UK/US operators they currently route through Ghana that could be extended into The Gambia.
engagement_goal: Open a regional cooperation conversation — joint multi-country itineraries (e.g. Senegal + Gambia + Ghana) and reciprocal referrals of clients between Ashanti's and Gambian ground operators.

name: Rockjumper Birding Tours
summary: One of the world's largest specialist birding tour operators (Pietermaritzburg, SA), running scheduled set-departure tours across all continents. They run a confirmed "Gambia & Senegal" combined birding tour as part of their Africa programme.
why_relevant: Confirmed active Gambia seller with global reach into the serious-birder market — exactly the operator profile Gambian DMCs want to maintain and deepen relationships with.
engagement_goal: Meet their Africa product manager to review ground service quality, request next-year departure forecasts, and ensure local Gambian DMC pricing/availability is fed in for 2026/27.

name: Naturetrek
summary: The UK's largest wildlife and birding holiday operator (AITO member, c. 700+ tours/year). Confirmed active Gambia seller with multiple distinct products: an 11/12-day River Gambia birding tour and a year-round monthly "Gambia in Style" holiday from Mandina Lodges in Makasutu Forest.
why_relevant: The single most important UK trade buyer for Gambia by volume of UK clients sent — already deeply embedded with ground operators and lodges. A relationship that must be protected and grown.
engagement_goal: Brief Naturetrek's Africa product team on new Gambian product (community lodges, upcountry circuits, new guide cohorts) and explore co-marketing for the 2026/27 season.

name: Birdfinders
summary: UK specialist birding tour operator (c. 200 tours/year worldwide) targeting committed birders. Runs a confirmed 15-day Gambia tour featuring Egyptian Plover, Martial Eagle, African Finfoot and Marakissa-based forest birding, with Banjul-based coastal hotel basing plus upcountry sites.
why_relevant: Confirmed Gambia seller with a long-running annual departure — a core UK trade buyer that already understands the destination and likely has repeat clients.
engagement_goal: Confirm 2026/27 departure dates, scout new sites to refresh the itinerary, and explore adding an upcountry/community-tourism extension.

name: Limosa Holidays
summary: One of the UK's longest-established specialist bird tour operators (Surrey-based), running a worldwide birding programme. Confirmed Gambia seller; leaders have guided in The Gambia for many years. Now part of the same company as Wildwings.
why_relevant: Established Gambia buyer with a loyal repeat-client base in the UK serious-birder segment; a relationship to defend and renew.
engagement_goal: Reconfirm current Gambia leader, scout potential new sites/lodges, and align on 2026/27 departures.

name: Heatherlea Birdwatching Ltd
summary: 35-year-old Scottish ATOL-licensed birding holiday operator (Cairngorms-based, own hotel). Africa programme covers Kenya, Botswana, Morocco and The Gambia — an 11-day Gambia holiday across three centres covering mangrove swamp, tidal estuaries, riverine forest, marshland and the West African forest edge.
why_relevant: Confirmed Gambia seller with a Scottish/north-of-England catchment that complements Naturetrek's southern UK base — diversifies the UK source-market footprint into Gambia.
engagement_goal: Maintain current product, brief them on new ground operator options, and explore upcountry/Senegal extensions.

name: Wildlife Worldwide & The Travelling Naturalist
summary: Sister brands (under the Wildlife Worldwide group) covering wildlife and birding tours globally. Both run Gambia products: Wildlife Worldwide's group tours and The Travelling Naturalist's 12-day "Gambia & Senegal: Superb West African Birdwatching" from £3,495 incl. flights.
why_relevant: Two trading brands under one roof both sending UK clients to Gambia — high-value relationship that already routes serious birders and naturalist generalists into Gambian ground services.
engagement_goal: Meet the product director to refresh ground supplier relationships, validate 2026/27 set-departures, and offer fam-trip support for new content.

name: African Bird Club
summary: UK-registered charity founded 1994, c. 1,200 members in 70+ countries, dedicated to African bird conservation. Has disbursed £500k+ across 300+ conservation projects in 45 African countries via its Conservation Fund — including funded projects in The Gambia (bird ringing scheme, Common Nightingale tracking UK–West Africa) and a dedicated Gambia country page.
why_relevant: The single most influential UK-based ornithological membership body for the African market; its members are exactly the high-spend, low-volume birding tourists Gambia wants. Already actively engaged with Gambia conservation projects.
engagement_goal: Coordinate on ABC's Gambia content (country page, project funding pipeline), invite ABC to endorse a future Gambia birding festival, and secure a member-club newsletter slot.

name: BirdLife International
summary: The world's largest nature conservation partnership of national bird/biodiversity organisations. West Africa partners directly relevant to Gambia include WABSA (West African Bird Study Association — The Gambia), NCD (Senegal) and ODZH (Guinea-Bissau). Runs flyway and seabird programmes covering the Gambia coast and inland wetlands.
why_relevant: The strategic institutional partner for any pan–West-Africa flyway conservation positioning, and the umbrella that includes The Gambia's own national partner WABSA — a credible channel into international donor and academic networks.
engagement_goal: Coordinate with the BirdLife Africa team and WABSA on joint visibility (e.g. Atlantic Flyway storytelling) and explore site-IBA tourism overlays that benefit community lodges.

why_relevant: Tailor-made Africa specialist with a UK client base could plausibly add a Gambia birding extension if approached with a ready-made product and pricing.
